_doc: Ticket 21.5's routing table: which .c every pool_fdps function and every game-owned global belongs in, decided before ticket 22 and 23 start emitting so that no emit round has to choose a file. Keys are entry-point addresses. `est_lines` is the Ghidra decompiled line count the file's size was budgeted from, not a promise about the emitted C. Regenerate with tools/code_emit/build_routing.py, whose tables hold the decisions; rebuild_info/code_layout.md explains them and owns the rule for what to do when a file outgrows its budget.

00013e10.name: fdps_map_find_chest_cell
00013e10.routing_note: Named for the map layer but it exists only to answer the AI's 'where is the chest' question; its one caller is the AI step.

00014140.name: fdps_draw_composite_sprite
00014140.routing_note: The generic sprite-request drawer every animation goes through, not map drawing; grouped with the other sprite primitives.

00015860.name: fdps_render_ring_menu_frame
00015860.routing_note: Renders the ring menu the menu loop drives; its callers are the menu open/close/input trio.

000177d0.name: fdps_load_and_draw_portrait
000177d0.routing_note: FACE.CEL portraits: two of its three callers are the message windows, which is where the portrait buffer is owned.

00017990.name: fdps_prompt_two_choice
00017990.routing_note: A modal window with its own input loop -- the same family as the message windows, not part of any one of its many callers.

000183d0.name: fdps_options_menu
000183d0.routing_note: Built out of the shared menu open/cursor/close primitives; a menu instance, not a settings subsystem.

0001ba40.name: fdps_play_ending_credit_roll
0001ba40.routing_note: The ending sequence is a file of its own: one animated epilogue card per roster member, reached from two chapter endings and owned by neither, and big enough that title.c cannot hold it and the title screen too.

0001d6c0.name: fdps_play_death_animation_and_mark_dead
0001d6c0.routing_note: The death sequence and the scripts it fires are one pipeline.

0001d990.name: fdps_run_death_scripts
0001d990.routing_note: Pays out and fires what fdps_collect_death_scripts gathered.

0001e370.name: fdps_level_up_apply_stat_gain
0001e370.routing_note: Its only caller is fdps_unit_award_exp_and_level_up and it writes unit stat fields.

0001e840.name: fdps_animate_turn_banner
0001e840.routing_note: A VFS/SAF animation player like the rest of anim.c, not part of the battle turn logic it announces.

0001ea80.name: fdps_draw_turn_number
0001ea80.routing_note: Draws into the turn banner's own sprite request, and nothing else.

0001ecf0.name: fdps_saf_play_over_background
0001ecf0.routing_note: Kept with the SAF frame reader rather than anim.c: it is the SAF player itself, which anim.c drives.

0001ef40.name: fdps_play_attack_animation
0001ef40.routing_note: The on-map playback half of a blow; the numeric resolution it accompanies is combat.c's.

0001fa30.name: fdps_battle_tick_status_effects
0001fa30.routing_note: Ticks poison and the other per-unit status effects, so it belongs with the code that applies and clears them, not with the turn engine that calls it once a turn.

00020c60.name: fdps_show_chapter_title_card
00020c60.routing_note: Chapter-level presentation called by all thirty inits; it belongs to the chapter frame, not to any one chapter.

000222c0.name: fdps_saf_play_over_scene
000222c0.routing_note: The same player, compositing over the live scene.

000227e0.name: fdps_field_load_chapter_resources
000227e0.routing_note: Chapter resource load-and-free, the same job as the field variant.

00022be0.name: fdps_build_map_unit_array
00022be0.routing_note: Builds the unit array the deployment table fills; head of the deployment pipeline.

00022e30.name: fdps_load_indexed_archive_entry
00022e30.routing_note: Generic indexed-archive reader with no caller, so grouped by job.

00023050.name: fdps_cache_cel_sprite_group
00023050.routing_note: The .CEL sprite cache, read by seven unrelated callers.

00026e00.name: fdps_play_vfs_animation_over_units
00026e00.routing_note: The same playback, per unit cell.

000276f0.name: fdps_draw_spell_list_page
000276f0.routing_note: The spell list UI page, drawn only for the spell menus.

000282b0.name: fdps_set_flag_bit
000282b0.routing_note: Writes a per-unit flag bitfield through fdps_get_unit_record.

0002a240.name: fdps_baseani_get_entry_or_exit
0002a240.routing_note: Resident BaseAni.vfs accessor, used only by the banner animation.

0002db50.name: fdps_units_clear_status_bit7
0002db50.routing_note: Sweeps the unit record array clearing one status bit.

0002df90.name: fdps_relocate_unit_array
0002df90.routing_note: Moves the unit record array; the owner of that array's storage.

0002e160.name: fdps_battle_map_overview
0002e160.routing_note: The overview screen itself, split out of the battle engine with its renderer so the pair stays together.

0002e5e0.name: fdps_fill_screen_square
0002e5e0.routing_note: Paints a solid square straight into the mode 13h screen -- a blit primitive, not part of the overview screen that calls it.

0002e710.name: fdps_render_map_overview_scaled
0002e710.routing_note: The scaled map render exists only for the overview screen.

00031540.name: fdps_load_field_chapter_resources
00031540.routing_note: Chapter resource load-and-free for the village side.

00032370.name: fdps_draw_party_gold
00032370.routing_note: The gold readout is drawn by seven village and shop screens and by nothing else.

000357a0.name: fdps_check_secret_code_key
000357a0.routing_note: Feeds the signboard menu's secret unlock code.

00036b60.name: fdps_object_set_field34_low_nibble_range
00036b60.routing_note: Writes unit record field 0x34 over an index range.
